🏡 Ready to take the first step toward homeownership?

Join Lisa Higdon & Andrew Liebers for a FREE live webinar covering Colorado first-time homebuyer programs, down payment assistance, financing options, and more!

📅 October 1, 2026 | 🕕 6 PM MT
💻 Live Online | 🎟️ Register today!

Bring your questions—we’ll help you understand your options. 🏡✨

⚡ NOW HIRING: Apprentice Electrician ⚡
The Electric Company, Inc. is a local, family-owned and operated residential electrical company serving Castle Rock, Castle Pines, and the Denver front range, and we're looking to add an apprentice to our team!

We're not a corporate outfit. You won't be just a number here. You'll work directly alongside the owners, learn the trade the right way, and be part of a small crew that genuinely cares about quality work and about each other.

What we're looking for:

🔌 Some electrical experience highly preferred (residential a plus)

🔌 Reliable, shows up on time, and takes pride in their work

🔌 Eager to learn and grow in the trade

🔌 Valid driver's license and reliable transportation

🔌 Must pass a background check and drug screen

🔌 Drug-free workplace; THC is not part of our pre-employment screening. Any sign of impairment on the job site will result in immediate termination.

What you get:

🏡 A family business that invests in you

🛠️ Hands-on training in residential new work, remodels, and service

📈 Room to grow with a growing company

If you're tired of feeling like a cog in a big machine and want to build a real career with people who have your back, we'd love to hear from you!

📧 Send your resume to lauren.tecservice@gmail.com

🌐 www.tecservicecolorado.com

Feel free to share or tag someone who'd be a great fit! 👇
